targets.outcome_quote: Of the 16 effects, we replicated 14 of them. Of the two that did not replicate, one was in the correct direction. Given the number of effects that replicated, I deem this a successful replication.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Post-completion registration explicitly deems the entire replication successful. That overall verdict takes precedence over individual failed effects in the detailed report.
